rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a character’s staged speech revealing their thoughts to the audience.

example.english: This soliloquy clearly reveals the protagonist's inner struggle to the audience.
example.traditional: 呢段獨白將主角內心嘅掙扎，清楚咁呈現畀觀眾睇。
